description: Family reunification in Switzerland (AIG Art. 42 to 47, VZAE 73 to 73b): who can bring a spouse and children under 18, entitlement (Swiss citizens, C permit) or discretion (B, L), the conditions (living together, housing, no social assistance, language), the 5-year deadline (12 months for children over 12) and the language levels, each with its law article. sponsor = status of the person in Switzerland.
name: family_reunification
